text:
jessica (CSM): Hey team — Acme Corp renewal next Tues. They just submitted an updated vendor risk questionnaire and asked for our SOC2 Type II report + signed DPA. Can we share the SOC2 and confirm the latest DPA is available? Need answers for: data residency, subprocessors, incident response SLA. cc @mike @laura :pray:

mike (Security): We can share a redacted SOC2 report and the SOC2 cover letter. Full evidence bundle no. I can pull latest redacted PDF from the compliance vault. Which fields on the questionnaire are they forcing into the form?

jessica (CSM): Main asks: 1) Where customer data is stored (regions), 2) list of subprocessors, 3) incident notification SLA (hours), 4) encryption at rest/in transit details. Also they want our standard DPA attached.

mike (Security): Ok. Quick answers: data stored in AWS us-east-1 and eu-west-1 (primary/replica). Subprocessors: see short list below. Incident SLA: we commit to notify within 72 hours for security incidents, critical pager immediately. Encryption: TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest with KMS. I'll draft formal wording.

sam (Infra): Subprocessors (high level): AWS, Datadog, Sentry, PostgresDB managed by RDS, SendGrid (emails). Can provide SOC2-ready attestation statements for each where available.

mike (Security): Action plan:
```
- I will pull redacted SOC2 PDF and cover letter (compliance vault) -> location: https://drive.redwood.company/compliance/soc2/2025-redacted.pdf
- Laura to confirm DPA template + signature flow
- Sam to confirm subprocessors + any downstream contracts
- Jess to send questionnaire spreadsheet to me and Laura
```

laura (Legal): DPA: we have approved master DPA v1.3. For renewal we can send the standard DPA and a countersign request via DocuSign. If Acme requests changes, route to me. Also note: for certain enterprise clauses (data localization, breach penalties) need legal review.

ops-bot: Reminder: compliance request created #C-4592. Please attach artifacts to the ticket for audit trace.

jessica (CSM): I'll upload the vendor questionnaire spreadsheet to the ticket now and drop answers where I can. Mike/Laura — can you aim to have draft responses and the SOC2/DPA links by EOD Friday? That's our cutoff to get to Acme before renewal. :clock10:

mike (Security): Friday EOD works. I'll redact and post link here when done.

laura (Legal): I'll prepare the DPA send and note any potential redlines. Expect a draft email template by Friday.

jessica (CSM): Awesome, thanks all. I'll coordinate with Acme and set expectation of receiving docs next week. Posting checklist here for tracking:
```
- [ ] SOC2 redacted PDF shared
- [ ] DPA sent (DocuSign)
- [ ] Questionnaire answered and uploaded
- [ ] Subprocessor attestations attached
- [ ] Audit ticket closed
```

mike (Security): Adding one more: if they ask for pen test report, we only share high-level summary. Ping me if they escalate. :triangular_flag_on_post:

jessica (CSM): noted. Thanks everyone — will follow up in the ticket and loop Acme once we have the docs. :thumbsup:
